single_changed_variable: replace every ticket execution with one causal hourly pair target and differential turnover
signal_rule: all expected V4 orders remain in the source ledger; no signal is removed because of cost
checkpoint_rule: a source fill timestamp becomes eligible only at the strictly following UTC hour checkpoint
target_rule: per pair target is sign of the prior hour selected-direction sum; an exact tie is flat
persistence_rule: same pair and same target direction carries without close and reopen
flat_rule: no eligible signal for the checkpoint means flat for the following interval
sizing: fixed 1/28 NAV notional per pair; portfolio gross leverage never exceeds 1.0

execution.price: first recorded M5 BID/ASK open at checkpoint

rejection: walk-forward RAW total multiple is not above 1.0
walk-forward normal or adverse total multiple is not above 1.0
target construction reads signals from the current or future checkpoint hour
